messages:
Elena: quick heads-up after testing the console at 320px and 375px. two regressions: action icons overlap on narrow rows and sidebar opens as a push, nudging table content off-screen. screenshots in thread.
Chris: thanks. I see the overlap. touch targets look <44px and the kebab menu is hard to hit.
Diego: dev note 1: overlay breakpoint is set at 480 but the runtime reads window.innerWidth rounded down; on some devices rounding causes push behavior at 360-370.
Maya: accessibility: when sidebar opens it gets focus but there is no announced close control. also keyboard users can't reach hidden columns when collapsed.
Elena: design idea: collapse low-priority columns into a per-row "More" panel and show a +n badge on rows with hidden fields. keep primary: name, status, last-seen, actions.
Chris: agree. also propose increasing hit area for icons by wrapping them in a 44px button with visual padding kept small.
Diego: implementation plan: add .compact-columns for <=360 and a small debounce to fix the rounding bug. fallback: horizontal scroll for no-js.
Maya: ARIA: kebab should have aria-label="More details for {name}" and when panel opens trap focus, esc closes and focus returns to trigger. set inert on main content when overlay is active.
Elena: copy tweak: change small-screen "Filters" label to "Refine" to reduce width. check translations.
Chris: quick CSS to try:
```
.row .hit-area { padding: 10px; margin: -10px; }
.table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }
.table thead { position: sticky; top: 56px; z-index: 40; }
```
Diego: will open a tiny PR with overlay fix + compact-columns and the hit-area change.
QA-bot: checklist added: VoiceOver, TalkBack, 200% zoom, i18n lengths, keyboard nav, touch-target verification.
Elena: action items: Diego to PR, Chris to update small-screen mocks, Maya to run a11y once PR is ready. deadline: EOD Thu.
design-bot: reminder 1: mobile design review Thu 9:30am in #design. :spiral_calendar:
